description: Provide a public domain, HTTP(S) URL or email to retrieve Google DNS and RDAP observations. Returns DNS record sets, provider DNSSEC AD flag, registration metadata, capture times and per-query gaps. Failed queries remain unknown rather than absent. AD and descriptive hygiene fields do not certify domain security, ownership or legitimacy. [x402: 0.001 USDC per call on Base]
